correctness.rationale: Automorphisms partition every unordered two-vertex leader set into exactly three types. A grounded-block Schur complement calculation derives all three rational inverse traces; their differences are strictly controlled for all positive t. Specifically B-C=t(2mt+2m+5t+3)/(2(1+t)(1+2t))>0 and C-A=((2m-7)t+2m-3)/(2(1+2t)), proving exact transitions and all tie cases for every integer m>=2. Full independent rational grounded inversions from the supplied checker cover 1,525 pair instances, 30 complete minimizer classifications and 90 additional representative inversions; infinite validity rests on the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The complete two-leader design decision on a modular triangular network changes qualitatively with triangle-internal coupling: two sharp conductance thresholds exist only for two- and three-module graphs, while four or more modules exhibit absolute hub-placement rigidity across all t>0. All minimizers, ties and performance values are explicit and valid for every integer number of triangles and real parameter, resolving a natural exact classification rather than a numerical slice or unmotivated invariant.
